payment_terms: Compensation is not specified in the intake and should be set out in Schedule A. Any approved ad spend remains subject to the $2,000 per day cap unless the Client gives written approval to exceed it. purpose: Confidentiality relationship: details below follow your notes. The Client is hiring the Paid Media Agency to plan, manage, and optimize paid media campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok. The Client owns all ad accounts, pixels, audiences, and creative assets, and the Agency will use those assets only to run the agreed campaigns for the Client. The Agency must keep spend controls in place, and it may not exceed $2,000 per day in ad spend without the Client’s written approval. The Agency will provide a weekly KPI dashboard every Monday so the Client can track performance and make approval decisions. If ROAS stays below 1.8 for 30 days, either party may trigger a reset plan or terminate the engagement. If the Client asks for it, the Agency will stop running campaigns for [ADDRESS_1] competitors for 90 days after the reset or termination event, to the extent that restriction is included in the final signed deal.
title: Confidentiality and Commercial Protections Agreement
